notes.title: Bug Fixes - round 1
notes.notes:
Hey there, VR surgeons.

We’ve just updated the experience with a few little bug fixes that we discovered since the release yesterday. Quick, aren’t we? =D

Here’s what has changed:

Archimedes’ (the bird) cute little chirrup was cutting off abruptly. Now when you throw things at him, his dulcet tones are much more pleasing.

As in real life, hitting The Heavy’s head or groin causes a lot more damage than other body parts - PLUS -  there is now visible damage to the blood bag, so you can see how much you’re hurting him.

There is a quicker balloon pop effect, so the confetti now showers you in a more pleasing fashion. No-one likes slow confetti.

You couldn’t pick up balloons before after they fell from the ceiling. Now you can, so that’s 100% more party-while-you-play.

There was a strange seam between The Heavy’s torso and legs after healing him. That’s now fixed, and he looks splendid.

When you win, the jingle should play correctly so you know when to celebrate.

That’s all for now. Any bugs you find (fingers crossed - NONE!) should be reported to surgeonfeedback@bossastudios.com.

Love and kisses,

The Surgeon Simulator Team
